content: ElevenLabs TTS API: streaming via POST /v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}/stream returns chunked MP3/PCM. Models: eleven_flash_v2_5 (~75ms latency, 32 langs), eleven_turbo_v2_5 (~250ms), eleven_multilingual_v2 (highest quality, 29 langs). WebSocket API also available for bidirectional streaming.
